description: This file contains functions related to firmware image validation and signature checking, specifically for use with fwtool, ucert, and associated metadata. It appears to be part of the OpenWRT firmware upgrade process, defining validation procedures for image signatures and metadata compatibility.

methods.name: fwtool_check_signature
methods.description: Checks the signature of a firmware image using fwtool and ucert, including validation against a signature certificate file.

methods.name: fwtool_check_image
methods.description: Validates firmware image metadata and device compatibility, including checks for version support and configuration interoperability.
